expectations.text: States plainly that the not-empty check is insufficient
expectations.evidence: Your test would have been green for all three weeks. You've added a check that cannot fail on the incident it was written for.

expectations.text: Identifies the COALESCE to zero as the mechanism that made the failure silent
expectations.evidence: COALESCE(revenue, 0)...Null means 'we don't know.' Zero means 'we know, and it's nothing.' Coalescing destroys that distinction irreversibly

expectations.text: Recommends reconciliation against a source of truth, not only shape checks
expectations.evidence: Reconciliation to source, blocking publish—daily warehouse revenue total vs. the billing system total. Only 'does it agree' catches this class.

expectations.text: Recommends that assertions run before publication rather than after, so bad data cannot reach the dashboard
expectations.evidence: Build → staging → test → promote ordering, so 1–4 can actually stop publication instead of emailing about it

expectations.text: Recommends a data contract or schema check so an upstream rename fails loudly and attributably
expectations.evidence: Schema contract at ingest—explicit column list, assert the expected set on read. Rename → hard failure at the boundary, attributable to upstream

expectations.text: Recommends volume or null-rate assertions rather than only a non-empty check
expectations.evidence: Join match-rate assertion, row-count surfaced on the dashboard face, and multiple other assertions beyond non-empty check

expectations.text: Treats three weeks of nobody noticing as a detection gap worth its own fix
expectations.evidence: It ran monthly, with three weeks of lag, executed by a human. That's rung 3 at its slowest.

expectations.text: Explains why a silently wrong number is more dangerous than a failed pipeline
expectations.evidence: COALESCE(x, -1) would have screamed on day one...destroys that distinction irreversibly—no downstream check anywhere can recover the difference. Directly contrasts plausibility (masks error) with implausibility (alerts immediately).
